label: validation
method: Fixed quota: select exactly N of the actual 49-50 eligible hole maps. Weight 1 uses a uniform independent seeded shuffle; other weights use exponential priority races with the specified weight on focus tiers and all other tiers at weight 1. Selected map budgets/counts unchanged. Omitted hole maps become ordinary clear resource maps. N=49 represents the unthinned baseline. Same seeds and choices paired across scenarios.
limitations: No terrain distribution knowledge, hidden source locations or hidden bills guide player policies.
Immediate visits after purchases; advance purchases and grandfathered started quotes are not exploited.
Gate uses generated holes only. Existing map access remains available.
Existing reserved Lakes, camps, Golems, clear outposts and corners are unchanged.
Each retained hole map still gets 1-5 holes with the agreed candidate-size/budget model.
Targets are medians, not per-world guarantees. Route-network sharing is heuristic; all four corner paths retain exact 10-hop length.
Graph/budget estimate, not a factory affordability, physical routing, timing or victory run.
